title: Annotatio II §.IX open: Cameracensis opinion not charged to today’s Lutherans — they refuse it
pass_a_gloss: §. IX. Whatever indeed be made of Luther and his Sentence, and whether that be judged the same as or diverse from the Cambrai [cardinal’s], it suffices for us, toward not imputing the Cambrai opinion to today’s Lutherans, that they are unwilling to have it ascribed to themselves.
pass_b_english: §.IX: whatever one makes of Luther versus Cambrai, today’s Lutherans will not wear Cambrai’s opinion as theirs.
That refusal is enough — we do not impute it to them.
source_text: §. IX. Quicquid verò de Luthero ejusque Sententia fiat, istaque vel eadem, vel diversa, à Cameracensis, æstimetur, nobis sufficit, ad non imputandam Cameracensis opinionem hodiernis Lutheranis, hos eam nolle sibi adscriptam.

lemmas.gloss: unwilling to have it ascribed to themselves

choices.english: unwilling to have it ascribed to themselves
rejected: unwilling to have it as a script

notes: §.IX open; Cambrai not charged to today’s Lutherans.
